The Miraclz Tower 2BR is AED 9,000/month all-inclusive from September 20, with just the AED 2,000 refundable deposit on top.

For something closer to the metro, there's a 2BR in Downtown Views 2 at AED 8,000/month: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-zabeel-zabeel-2-downtown-views-ii-downtown-views-ii-tower-2-2PrelS1ahXc.html

Want to see either in person, Pascal?
